sources.title: quotientai/limbic-tool-use-0.5B-32K · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Limbic-Tool-Use MCP Function Call Evaluator This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen2.5-.5B-Instruct specifically designed for evaluating function calls in the context of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. It can assess whether a function call is correct, uses the wrong tool, has incorrect parameter names, or has incorrect parameter values.
